name: io.github.evolvconsulting/fast-mcp-jobvite
description: An MCP server for the Jobvite ATS: candidate and job reads, and one gated write.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Jobvite v2 API key, sent as the x-jvi-api header. Required by every tool except get_job_feed.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Jobvite v2 API secret, sent as the x-jvi-sc header. Required by every tool except get_job_feed.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_FEED_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Jobvite v1 job-feed key. Required only by get_job_feed.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_FEED_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Jobvite v1 job-feed secret. Required only by get_job_feed. Travels in the query string, so the feed URL is treated as sensitive.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_COMPANY_ID
environmentVariables.description: The job feed's separate credential: the value after c= in the career-site URL. Required only by get_job_feed.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of tool names. Unset means all read tools and never the write. An unrecognised name is a startup failure.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: create_candidate is registered only when this is true AND the tool is named in JOBVITE_TOOLS. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: stdio (default) or http. stdio is unauthenticated by design; the operating system process boundary is the control.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP bind address. Only read when the transport is http. A non-loopback value requires JOBVITE_TLS_TERMINATED_BY_PROXY=true or the server refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP bind port. Only read when the transport is http.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_HTTP_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Bearer tokens for the HTTP transport, as a JSON object mapping each token to its scopes over the three data classes. Unset while the transport is http is a startup failure, not an open server.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_TLS_TERMINATED_BY_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set true only when TLS is terminated by a proxy in front of this server. It is an operator assertion the server cannot verify, and deliberately not a check of X-Forwarded-Proto, which is spoofable.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_MAX_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: In-tool result cap. A search returning more reports the total rather than truncating silently.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_OUTBOUND_RATE_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Outbound self-throttle against Jobvite, requests per minute. A conservative guess, not a vendor figure: Jobvite documents no numeric rate limit.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_OUTBOUND_BUDGET_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Total wall-clock budget for all outbound attempts in one tool invocation, in seconds. Not a per-request timeout: a scan making twenty-five requests shares one budget. A choice, not a measured figure.

environmentVariables.name: JOBVITE_PAGINATION_START_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Pagination base per resource. Ships 1-based on Jobvite's own v1 documentation; scans start at 0 regardless so a 0-based server cannot lose record zero. Override only against a live tenant.
